rate_path.rationale: The minutes show a strong consensus to maintain the current federal funds rate target range well beyond the unemployment threshold, with no push for rate increases or cuts. Most participants oppose lowering the threshold and favor qualitative guidance, indicating a balanced stance with no clear direction toward tighter or easier policy.

evidence.quote: The Committee now anticipates, based on its assessment of these factors, that it likely will be appropriate to maintain the current target range for the federal funds rate well past the time that the unemployment rate declines below 6-1/2 percent,
